items.text: Cardinals trade WR Marvin Harrison Jr. (and 2027 7th) to Texans for 2027 2nd + 6th; MHJ inactive for Week 5, changes bio. Rap corroborates blockbuster.
items.implication: MHJ joins Nico Collins/Boutte room in HOU; boosts HOU pass game depth long-term, ARI WR vacuum
items.opportunity: Targets for remaining ARI WRs short-term; MHJ ROS in better offense

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery downgraded to out (groin); was being watched by ETR.
items.why: Schefter downgrade; Rap had Q earlier
items.implication: Sit; opens backfield for Marks or others

items.text: Ashton Jeanty will play (FINAL UPDATE) after GTD for ankle/plantar fasciitis; Rap confirmed go after pregame workout.
items.implication: Start as RB1 but monitor workload/possible limit

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is active vs Saints after GTD/questionable (ankle); Addison inactive.
items.why: Official active confirmation; wanted to play in Louisiana
items.implication: Must-start WR1; volume concentrated without Addison

items.text: Vikings WR Jordan Addison inactive (hamstring) while Jefferson active.
items.why: Official inactives; ETR had not expected to play

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase (previously questionable/concussion) will play vs Dolphins; ETR final updates and projections adjusted accordingly after weekend reports.
items.why: ETR UPDATES post and Schefter confirmation both will play
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected with Burrow; start confidently

items.text: Tee Higgins (questionable, adductor/neck) will play alongside Chase vs Dolphins per ETR updates.
items.why: ETR and Schefter both confirm will play
items.implication: Maintains high-end WR2/flex value in good matchup

items.text: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel out remainder of game (hamstring); Rap confirmed ruled out.
Jaylen Warren passes every test (advanced stats, eye test) as Ekeler-esque workhorse; coaching staffs (including PIT) refused to go full workhorse even pre-Dowdle injury—insane.
items.why: Passes advanced/eye test; Dowdle out removes split
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex upgrade with clear path to workhorse role
items.opportunity: Carries, routes, third-down, goal-line with Dowdle OUT

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey active but not expected to play meaningful snaps (foot); ETR had not expected to play.
items.why: Schefter: active but no meaningful snaps
items.implication: Sit; avoid or pivot to others in LAC

items.text: Terry McLaurin will play (FINAL UPDATE) after GTD; Schefter listed among actives.
items.implication: Start with Daniels returning; primary WR

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams inactive (among listed inactives); ETR not expected to play.
Jahmyr Gibbs only 61.5% owned in DK single-entry double-ups yet delivered in cash; Levitan cash lineup review highlights value.
items.why: Low ownership relative to production in cash review
items.implication: Continue trusting as elite RB1; ownership inefficiencies exist

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere (post-Week 5 context).
items.implication: Priority add in leagues where available; monitor GB backfield
